_about: Outside write-up (HISTORY.md 11 Oct, docs/DECOMP_COMPARISON.md): each of its 769 entry addresses (its build) with our address. how: signature = its byte signature matched exactly one place here; drift = offset from the nearest signature-mapped entry, with equal span; citations / call links / combined = its cited instructions or call targets placed it, see DECOMP_COMPARISON.md; content = checked against an independent fact (DECOMP_COMPARISON.md lists them); rejected = 0x1002FFE0, call-link candidate whose first cited instruction does not match; unmapped = stubs or candidates nothing tells apart. their_name is their label, not a fact; our_name is ours (names_pending_idb.json, else the export). Their text is not in this repository.
